title: The Unofficial Group Chat
author: Marguerite Eastwick
blurb: Oscar Zhou, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
